title: Characterize exact binary and decimal source; establish C02 RED
commitMessage: test: establish exact binary and decimal RED

contribution.summary: Pin and inspect both authorized AURA ExactBinaryNumber and ExactDecimalFormatter sources, record their actual declared public surfaces, install an independent missing-types RED contract, refine C02 product readiness and align typed native DWF progress.
contribution.value: Creates grounded source-level evidence and a reproducible RED for the next substantial exact binary64 and decimal transfer, eliminating guessed APIs and preserving independent behavioral qualification.
debtChanges: The RED test proves missing types, not binary64 or rounding correctness. The source-declaration inventory supplies the observed API for subsequent GREEN and boundary tests.
C02 T2 boundary checks for non-finite input, subnormals, signed zero and precision remain unqualified; no AURA source is mutated.
contribution.nextAction: Use the recorded source declarations to transfer and qualify both exact binary and decimal types in one substantial GREEN and boundary-verification run.

achievements.achievement: Both authorized binary/decimal source candidates are independently hash-verified and their declarations recorded, while the Math assembly's missing-type RED is observed before transfer.
